subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Unit 2 – Lesson 6: Culture and Project – Technology helps us
outcomes: I can say how technology helps children with special needs.
I can match devices to the people they help.
I can make a spider diagram about technology and learning.

tf.s: Some deaf children use special alarm clocks with lights and vibrations.
tf.why: Yes! They can see or feel the alarm.

tf.s: Children in Oman who are deaf use the special alarm clocks in the text.
tf.why: The text says the children are in the UK.

tf.s: E-readers can make letters very large.
tf.why: Right! That helps people who cannot see well.

tf.s: Virtual Reality (VR) helps children with Down's Syndrome to paint.
People who cannot talk can use their eyes to make computers do things.
tf.why: Correct! Their eyes control the computer.

tf.s: Special alarm clocks for deaf children are very loud.
tf.why: They use lights and vibrations, not sound.

tf.s: With an e-reader, people who cannot see well can only read and never hear the words.
tf.why: They can also hear the words.

tf.s: We should be kind and respect people with special needs.
tf.why: Yes! Kindness and respect are important.

tf.s: In a spider diagram about technology, we write "Technology" in the middle.
tf.why: Great! The main idea goes in the middle.

tf.s: When you summarise, you say every small detail.
tf.why: Summarising means giving the most important information.

boxes.q: Which words mean a person needs extra help?
boxes.why: Special needs means a person needs extra help.

boxes.q: What helps children with Down's Syndrome to paint?
In which country do deaf children use special alarm clocks?
What does the class vote for at the end of the project?
boxes.why: The class votes for the best device for learning.

boxes.q: How do e-readers help people who cannot see well?
boxes.why: The letters can be very large.

boxes.q: What do we write in the middle of the spider diagram?
You can use a tablet to help you ___ notes.
OLPC stands for One Laptop per ___.
A person who cannot hear is ___.
How should we treat people with special needs?

mcq.q: How can children who are deaf wake up in the morning?
o: with special alarm clocks that use lights and vibrations
mcq.why: Lights and vibrations wake them up.

mcq.q: What can people who cannot talk use to make computers do things?

o: a poster with the main idea in the middle and branches
mcq.why: Branches come out from the main idea.

mcq.q: A boy can't see well. Which device helps him read?
mcq.why: Large letters and audio help him read.

mcq.q: Which sentence uses the project phrases correctly?
o: You can use a tablet to help you to take notes.
You can a tablet to help take notes.
You use can a tablet notes.
A tablet are very good at you.
mcq.why: You can use … to help you to …

mcq.q: Which sentence about learning with a device is correct?
o: I can watch videos on my computer to learn about science.
I can watch videos on my alarm clock to learn science.
I can print videos on my speaker.
I can learn science when I turn off everything.

mcq.q: A girl has difficulty holding a pen. Which technology helps her paint?
mcq.why: VR helps her paint without holding a pen.

mcq.q: Why do alarm clocks for deaf children use lights and vibrations?
mcq.why: They see or feel what they can't hear.

mcq.q: Why should you summarise when you present your poster?
o: So listeners understand the most important information quickly.
So the presentation is very long.
So you don't have to show the poster.
mcq.why: A summary gives the key ideas.
